RACE SIMULATION — ACT 1 OF 2

THE UNIT: 0:30 @116-124% (attack the base) → 3:00 @102-109% (sustain the climb) → 8:00 @83-88% (tempo over the top) — this is the crux demand of the race: attack a shorter climb, sustain it, then hold tempo over the top.

THE SHAPE: 4 units across 2.6hr of Z2 — Act 1 of 2. Each act packs them tighter; I've built it so race day is the only day you do the full count.

AUDIBLE: if the legs are gone after unit 3, skip the remaining attacks and ride the climbs at tempo — then finish the Z2.
